etsy.title: Classroom Kindness Calendar, December Kindness Challenge for Students, 24 Class Kindness Activities, Teacher Christmas Printable K-5
etsy.description:
A December countdown for your classroom that grows kind hearts – no elf and no candy needed. 🍎🎄

24 whole-class kindness missions, each with a quick teacher tip. Most take 5–20 minutes at morning meeting and need no shopping: thank-you cards for school helpers, compliment circles, reading buddies, gratitude chains and more.

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (11 pages)
• 24 kindness mission cards with teacher tips
• Printable wall calendar poster (color a square each day)
• 2-page class kindness tracker
• Kindness Champion student certificates (2 per page)
• Ready-to-send letter for families
• How-to page for teachers

🍎 For grades K–5, homeschool groups and clubs.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included.

LICENSE
For use in one classroom. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
